pick.name: Hetzner Cloud
pick.what: Cheap reliable VPS incl. Singapore region
pick.why: Predictable pricing, no reclaim risk, strong price-to-performance
pick.free_limits: No free tier; from EUR 5.99/mo (Cost-Optimized) / EUR 6.49 (Regular) excl. VAT per page today; DE/FI/SG/US

best_free.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free (Ampere A1)
best_free.what: Free ARM VM for Docker, Coolify, Uptime Kuma, self-hosted runners, cron
best_free.why: Only meaningful always-free VM: 2 OCPU/12 GB A1 + 2 AMD micros + 200 GB disk + 10 TB egress
best_free.free_limits: A1: 1,500 OCPU-h + 9,000 GB-h/mo = 2 OCPU/12 GB (doc today; older guides say 4/24); 2x E2.1.Micro 1 GB; 200 GB block; 10 TB/mo out; reclaimed if 95th-pct CPU, network and (A1) memory all <20% over 7 days; capacity often unavailable; card verification
best_free.install: web (OCI console) then: curl -fsSL https://cdn.coollabs.io/coolify/install.sh | bash (Coolify, optional)

alts.name: Fly.io pay-as-you-go
alts.why: Cheapest always-on container if you only need 256 MB
alts.free_limits: No free tier for new orgs (2 h runtime or 7-day trial); shared-cpu-1x 256 MB $2.19/mo, 1 GB $6.70/mo; dedicated IPv4 $2/mo

alts.name: Railway Hobby
alts.what: PaaS for containers, workers and DBs
alts.why: Pay-later pick: simplest container DX at $5/mo
alts.free_limits: Free: $1/mo credit, NO custom domains, 1 project/3 services; Hobby $5/mo incl. $5 usage, 2 custom domains, 50 services

candidates.name: Oracle Always Free
candidates.verdict: PICK: the only real always-free VM; accept reclaim/capacity risk

candidates.name: Hetzner Cloud
candidates.verdict: Alt: best paid value; first move when Oracle reclaims or capacity fails

candidates.name: Google Compute e2-micro free
candidates.verdict: Not verified this session; tiny (1 GB) and US-only per common knowledge

candidates.name: AWS Free Tier
candidates.verdict: Now credit-based ($200, used within 12 months) per AWS pricing pages; not always-free

candidates.name: Render/Koyeb free
candidates.verdict: Rejected: spin-down / free tier closed to new users

decision: Hetzner Cloud (about EUR 6/mo) is the best overall VM for a paying product: predictable and never reclaimed. Oracle Always Free is the only real $0 VM but can reclaim idle instances and often lacks capacity, so keep everything reproducible (Docker Compose). Fly.io suits tiny always-on containers.
details: Oracle's doc says A1 = 2 OCPU/12 GB, not the 4/24 older guides quote.

verify.note: Cost-Optimized from EUR 5.99/mo, Regular Performance from EUR 6.49/mo excl. VAT; DE/FI/SG/US. No price change announced on page.
